title: Notary Confi: Appointment Confirmations
description: Help Notary Confi, a notary and Spanish ⇄ English translation office, remind clients about appointments and read their replies over SMS, WhatsApp and email. A mock workflow: nothing is really sent.
questDescription: Send reminders, fill a WhatsApp template, read replies and fix a broken webhook.

flavorTextOverrides.bookshelf: A binder of notarized documents, each one stamped and sealed.
